name: Apartmentiq
description: ApartmentIQ is multifamily’s all-in-one, daily data platform covering 40M units. It integrates daily property and market signals into modern tools for market surveys, investment research, and revenue management. Owners, operators, and investors use ApartmentIQ to benchmark performance, price confidently, and move faster – trusted by 70% of the NMHC Top 50.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Apartmentiq to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Apartmentiq to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://data.apartmentiq.io/apartmentiq/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Apartmentiq MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Apartmentiq lists 25 MCP tools, including amenities_list, market_absorption_historicals_get, market_construction_pipeline_get, market_forecasts_get, market_historicals_get, market_narrative_get, market_properties_list, market_related_markets_get, market_summary_get, market_transactions_historicals_get, market_transactions_list, and markets_search.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Apartmentiq?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Apartmentiq in data-analytics on the Manufact MCP catalog include Epicure, Newsflash, Point Topic, Pricing Optimizer AI, and StatCite.
Apartmentiq requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Apartmentiq is developed by ApartmentIQ. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
